comment: ANCHOR: PROTECTIVE_PUT_ADVISORY_20261105 — FQ-142 / D32 SPEC section 5: advisory protective put or collar suggestions for single-stock positions above the configured share of the book with an event inside the window, carrying the floor and the cost (quoted premium or a LABELED estimate). Advisory only: the system never places, sizes, stops or cancels an order (AGENTS.md rule 1, MBI_BEHAVIOR = 0); the suite proves the module has no broker/writer import path and that BehaviorWriteRefused still raises on a behavior-shaped write.
